newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Coil unhappy with Paris Euro.NM listing.
newsitem.headline: Coil unhappy with Paris Euro.NM listing.

text.p: Belgian aluminium coatings firm Coil wants a secondary listing in Brussels because it is unhappy with the way its share has performed on the Paris segment of the Euro.NM market, company officials told Belgian newspaper L'Echo on Tuesday.

"We see that investors are still only paying little attention to this market and that intervention by market makers is relatively useless," chief executive officer Charles van der Haegen was quoted as saying.
The company has taken no decision on which Brussels bourse market to list on, but it is unlikely to be the main market.
"The company is not yet mature enough," van der Haegen said.
In Brussels Coil could go to the second market -- where prices are fixed twice daily -- the Brussels Euro.NM, or even the Brussels-based market for growth stocks Easdaq.
